purpose: Locally frozen follow-up, recorded before held-out outcome evaluation; not an external preregistration
transforms: Keep reference training-only selected pairs, scale and traffic factor unchanged for every comparison
selection: Each checkpoint selected only by its declared validation loss; evaluate all declared variants, never select on final test
held_out_rule: First seven complete test days with lookback and three forecast labels inside the test split; do not bridge missing timestamps
interpretation: One training seed; simulated capacities/workloads; carbon forwarding proxy; fresh only relative to recorded project experiments
